reasoning: Shows a document outline with a downward download arrow onto a tray bar at the bottom right. It is universally understood as downloading or exporting a file/document, fitting common admin, finance, and travel tasks where saving a local copy is the main action, though it must be distinguished from file upload or non-document media downloads.
